tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa la bsngags pa ka phreng mu tig do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄// sharaṇyāratnast+risaṃgho3karatwamahāgro3kṣarasyāsanānikṛtāpya/ dhwamatraṃkaṣasyadhwadzadhṛgnayeṇapradzābodhineyāgrashansākaromi// ༄༅// skyabs mchog riṃn cheṃn gsum tshogs 'byung ba'i gnas// che mchog miṃ 'gyuraṃ go 'phang mngon bgyis kyang*// dus 'dir ngur smrig rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn 'chang zol gyis// sems can byang chub 'khrid mchog bsngags par bgyi// dpag yas shes bya'i kaṃ ra mngar po'i bcud// bsam bsgom rtun pa'i khaṃ lces myang stobs kyis// lung rtogs yon tan gaṃ pur 'od can cha// kun nas rdzogs pas ngaṃ bdag mun pa bcil// don chung tshig gi caṃ cor dgyes min yang*// lus can mos pa'i chaṃ dang rjes mthun par// sdom gsum bdud rtsi jaṃ bzang btung ba ltar// 'gyed la dgyes 'dzum nyaṃ rgyas zla bzhin dkar// mkhyen dpyod rin chen taṃ la stong 'bar ba'i// ngo mtshar rjes 'gros thaṃ dad gdul bya'i blor// ji ltar 'tsham par daṃ ltar chos ston pas// mi 'gyur go 'phang naṃ rga med par 'khrid// brtse dang byang sems paṃ sangs ltar dkar bas// bsdu dngos bzhi dang phaṃ rol phyin drug spyod// sangs rgyas zhing khams baṃ spu'i grangs snyed sbyong*// sems can smin mdzad maṃ 'dris mdza' ba'i bshes// grangs med dkyil 'khor tsaṃkra'i gtsor bzhugs nas// sngags spyod gser gyi tshaṃ skyob blar 'khor ba'i// grib bsil yangs par dzaṃ lang skye bo tshun// sku bzhi'i bag chags waṃ ler 'jog la mkhas// legs bshad rin chen zhaṃ nye'i lhad med ltar// thar pa'i srog 'tshor zaṃ ma'i dga' ston bzhin// tshogs gsum lam nas 'aṃ 'ur rtag 'jo la// 'di na do zla'i yaṃ med mchog tu khums// kha ba'i rdul brtsegs raṃ bas bskor ba'i dbus// lam stor 'gro ba laṃ gor bde ba'i gnas// 'dren pa'i lam mkhan shaṃ ri'i bur mtshungs khyod// bskal par 'tsho gzhes saṃ steng rgyan du bzhugs// rtogs brjod rkang pas haṃ cang bsnun nyung yang*// bstod pa'i bsod nams aṃ sho ka'i me tog

/phyi nang yon tan 'dab ma stong grol nas// don gnyis grub pa'i ge sar ngom par shog /ces mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan pa la bsngags pa ka phreng mu tig do shal zhes bya ba 'di ni/ drung yig shes rab chos 'phel rang gi ngag 'don rgyur 'di bzhin dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ bstod yul dam pa'i bka' lung gi zil mngar gyis 'tsho ba'i slob 'bangs bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi grags pa'i mu khyud phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
